Two distinct, small, dark, bead-like eyes are clearly visible and symmetrically placed.
The ears are visible as small, rounded shapes on the top corners of the head, partially obscured by fur but anatomically correct in position and shape.

The rear of the hamster is facing away or tucked down, and the tail is completely occluded by the body fur and the sitting posture.

The area where the paws are tucked is slightly indistinct and blurry. While this mimics photographic focus issues, in AI images it can sometimes mask malformed limbs. However, no obvious structural collapse is visible.
